title: Combined-mode era roster and capability audit
summaryZh: 年代必须限制整套载具、弹药、挂载与传感器；双方共享同一年代池。
当前存在F-15E、A-10C、MiG-21MF、HunterF4/F6等旧ID/模型/能力混搭，已保留明确修复项和合适年代候选，未从最终模式删掉。
最小有来源支持的早期组合是MiG-15bis/F-86F配T-34-85/M4A3(76)W HVSS；现代飞机继续作为现代房要求。
全部已有雷达继续保留用户指定的Space+R高速准星格斗扫描；这是游戏辅助，不授予现代雷达或导弹兼容性。

baseline.groundCatalogSource: design worktree data/vehicles + data/projectiles + data/missiles.json; dates are catalog claims until primary-audited
baseline.embeddedDataNote: Ignored decoded cache differs from tracked gzip aggregate; all imported source identities and source hashes were independently compared to tracked compressed data. Use tracked gzip evidence for this study.

auditMeaning.verified_airframe_or_vehicle_candidate: A primary source corroborates the named family/variant and a relevant service-by date. It is a candidate, not a claim that every current store, physics estimate or sensor has historical certification.
auditMeaning.held_or_pending: Preserve in final requirement and explicit expansion list; resolve the recorded identity, date or implementation debt before enabling a strict historical profile.
auditMeaning.proposed_room_snapshot: A gameplay design cutoff and explicit profile whitelist, not a claim of a real Korean/Taiwan war or first service in that year. Countries do not determine team eligibility.
auditMeaning.unknown_dates: null/pending is never replaced by a guessed year or an automatic allow.
auditMeaning.older_airframes: A later snapshot can retain a specifically whitelisted older profile; do not use introductionYear>=roomStart as the sole eligibility rule.
auditMeaning.evidence_limits: Search results from official sources were read; some official pages reject direct opens with403. No secondary source is promoted to primary proof. No physics/radar range numbers are certified by this study.

evidence: handoff/bundle/app.js.html:35006 fighterType() keeps f as fighter but does not copy era onto the returned type.
handoff/bundle/app.js.html:38826 airOnlineLineup() reads T.era and permits !year.
findings.scope: An isolated execution of the actual fighterType function and lineup predicate reproduces UI eligibility. This is not evidence that the server accepts the sortie.
findings.remedy: Use stable, server-owned eraProfileId eligibility; fail closed on unknown profile, and obtain display dates from the same profile. Do not fix this only by changing a label.

findings.current_conflict: AIR_RADARS uses AN/APG-63 and generic Eagle configuration. The imported asset/source and display are E; training delivery1988 must not be conflated with IOC1989.
findings.remedy: Retain legacy ID for compatibility, add an explicit F-15E configuration profile with matched radar, cockpit, crew, weapons and operational date. Keep E as a pending candidate for1995 and modern rooms; do not silently substitute an F-15C1979 profile.

findings.current_conflict: AIR_EQUIP comment/config still identifies A-10A/Pave Penny; no C targeting pod, digital datalink or GPS-guided store definition is provided by changing the display.
findings.remedy: Keep A-10C as an explicit modern-room requirement. Audit C avionics/pod/store integration and separate an A-10A profile only if a matching representation/configuration is provided. Pave Penny alone is not a laser designator or a C targeting pod.

findings.current_conflict: Current gun tuple is nr30×1/130rounds, early two-station presets and gyro-only AIR_EQUIP with no AIR_RADARS entry. MF museum data specifies GSh-23L/200, four wing stations and Safir-21 radar.
findings.remedy: Retain MF model and provide a matched MF profile, cannon feed/ammo, four usable wing stations and documented radar. Add the user-requested Space+R game ACM when that real radar is implemented. Reconcile the prior user-requested130round setting explicitly rather than silently treating it as historical MF equipment. Pending candidate for1976 and later rooms.

findings.current_conflict: Embedded source.title and cg_why both say F.4; package is Desktop/Hunter_F4_TankForge.zip. F.6 display, engine/airframe and loadout limits cannot be certified by an F.4 source mesh.
findings.remedy: Choose and document a matched F.4 profile/flight model, or a verified F.6 representation. Retain Hunter candidate for the postwar room and later; do not delete the existing aircraft or invent F.4 service dates from F.6 evidence.

findings.current_conflict: Legacy key is not MirageIIIE. No radar is configured, which agrees with the simplified radarless Mirage5 concept. Current lcos/ccip flags and Magic1 preset still need a5F/date-matched sight and store clearance.
findings.remedy: Use an explicit Mirage5F profile; retain in1976 and later candidate pools. Do not import Cyrano/SARH/HMD capability from MirageIIIE/Mirage2000; verify the local1972 milestone and exact Magic1 equipment date.

findings.current_conflict: N001/HMS and domestic r27r/r27t/r73 IDs are used; existing export r27r1/r27t1/r73e definitions are distinct. No evidence of an RVV-AE-compatible modernization of this UBK was found.
findings.remedy: Keep UBK in the1995 pending expansion and modern requirement pool. Obtain exact delivery/configuration and export missile evidence; do not turn it into Su-27SM/Su-30MK2 by adding an active missile. A current photo proves service-by2018, not initial1992 service.

evidence: AD_SAMS.chaparral uses M901/M113-family hull instead of M730/M548.
AD_SAMS.kubRadar and kubLauncher use xp_bmp_k64 wheeled hull instead of the actual tracked carriers.
AD_SAMS.pantsir implements a Pantsir-S1-like suite; ru_pantsir_sm_sv asset is labelled SM-SV and native missile is explicitly a SACLOS gameplay substitute.
findings.remedy: Give each complete SAM system a separate era profile, including carrier/radar/missile. Keep later systems as candidate requirements pending matched models/configuration; never date an attached system from its borrowed chassis meta.year.

evidence: Ground catalog includes original/fictional prototypes and game conversions with ordinary years.
WEAPON_STATUS labels legacy_existing, secondary and game_test_platform; these are not primary historical capability or in-service-date proof.
AIR_STORE_DEFS numbers and AIR_RADARS ranges are explicitly game estimates.
findings.remedy: Separate provenance, historical release, integration compatibility and implemented functionality. A successful test verifies behavior, not the historical date of that behavior.

roomProposals.label: 早期喷气1953
sensor_and_store_policy: Gyro/optical gunsights only; Sabre ranging assistance is distinct from search radar.
Initial audited air profiles can be guns-only. Existing anm64/hvar/fab100 remain ground-attack candidates pending exact block/store clearance.
Optical gun AAA; no radar or SAM shortcut.
notes: Smallest source-backed combined-mode seed. F-86F family is verified; exact F-25 block and tank/rocket/bomb combinations still need clearance evidence.
T-54(1951) is not automatically a Korean War historical unit merely because its local year is1951. Fictional conflict can add it only through an explicit verified profile.

roomProposals.label: 战后喷气1965
sensor_and_store_policy: F-104G retains documented early pulse-radar class plus requested game ACM; no modern look-down/HMD/ARH inference.
aim9b is a dated component candidate for a clearance-verified F-104G profile. Earlier gun-only jets receive no missile retrofit by default.
No CCIP for gyro-only MiG-15bis/F-86/Hunter/MiG-17 simply because the common HUD renderer can draw it.
explicit_denials: All AMRAAM/AIM-9L/M/X and modern guided ground weapons
notes: Hunter remains a required pending candidate: resolve F4 model versus F6 performance first.
MiG-17F asset suffix/first-service date is pending;1965 is a conservative candidate cutoff, not an assertion that every local store was then cleared.

roomProposals.label: 超音速1976
sensor_and_store_policy: Mirage is5F and has no search radar; exact LCOS/CCIP/reticle and Magic1 clearance pending.
F-4E early/late equipment profiles must separate; current AIR_LOADOUTS mixes AIM-9L, Maverick, PaveSpike and laser bombs across dates.
AIM-9L1976 production and AGM-65A1972 acceptance are component lower bounds, not automatic1976 platform clearance.
Kub1967/Chaparral1969 are dated SAM candidates for rear objectives after visual/system-profile repair, not pre1965 fallback.
explicit_denials: Modern AESA/HMD/MAWS and future thermal upgrades
notes: Use fixed selected configurations rather than all presets.
Gepard family is dated1976 but local1A1 package requires modification-date review before1976 release.

roomProposals.label: 冷战1986
sensor_and_store_policy: MiG-299.12 retains N019, early IR/laser and helmet aiming; no R-77/AESA/modern datalink upgrade.
Su-25 retains its documented baseline attack configuration once Klen/sight/Kh store audit is complete; do not borrow Su-25T/Vikhr fit.
AGM-65D becomes an operational component candidate inFebruary1986; carrier-specific authorization still required.
T-72A1979 profile retains TPD-K1 laser and existing22round AZ load; no ERA/thermal/gun-launched ATGM or later APFSDS.
Gepard and paired Kub radar/launcher are rear-defense candidates; frontline pressure remains guns/short-range by design.
notes: This is the largest useful first Cold War candidate pool supported by local models. Verified vehicle family does not certify exact ammunition issue dates.
Do not replace the actual A-10C model by an unannounced A-10A1977 historical profile; add a matched A variant only as explicit work.

roomProposals.label: 后冷战1995
sensor_and_store_policy: F-15E is a required pending addition after E radar/crew/loadout reconciliation, using operational date1989 rather than family1979 or training1988.
Su-27UBK is a required pending addition after verifying initial delivery, N001 fit and export missile subtype. No R-77 assumption.
AIM-120A1991 candidate only on a compatible, separately dated carrier profile;120B/120C exact dates remain pending.
TOW baseline remains separate from TOW2/tandem/top-attack or thermal upgrades.
explicit_denials: Pantsir-SM-SV date inferred from borrowed chassis
notes: Pending does not remove these aircraft from the final mode: each has a remediation item and stays in the expansion target.
Retention of older types is a room-balance decision; no rule that an older aircraft disappears merely because its introduction date is outside a lower bracket bound.

roomProposals.label: 现代2022
sensor_and_store_policy: F-16V/APG-83 belongs here as a modern configuration; ROCAF2021 operational-wing evidence supports conservative2022 candidate use.
A-10C and F-15E remain required modern candidates pending complete matched avionics/targeting/store profiles.
Modern room does not mean every missile on every aircraft: f16v may use only source-backed compatible lots; base MiG-299.12/Su-27UBK do not gain R-77 automatically.
Older T-72A can remain an explicitly selected legacy ground profile, but no implicit T-72B3/thermal/late ammo update.
Pantsir-SM-SV is a pending distinct modern profile; resolve the S1/SM-SV model and guidance substitution and gate its use to rear-defense budgets.
explicit_denials: Meteor/MICA/IRIS-T/ASRAAM/Phoenix assigned solely because they exist in the test catalog
All unverified custom/prototype ground platforms as historical line units
notes: Modern aircraft are part of the final combined-mode requirement. This first study flags integration work instead of silently dropping them.
There is no existing modern NATO MBT/real production IFV/APC roster in this47vehicle catalog. Both teams can initially share T-72A, but broader modern ground diversity requires new audited assets.

groundAmmoProfiles.policy: Candidate85mm APHE/HE baseline; exact APCR issue/variant date must be verified rather than inherited from universal ammo menu.
CandidateM62/HE baseline; do not infer plentiful M93 HVAP from vehicle year. Exact allocation is a gameplay choice after component availability audit.
No stabilizer, laser, thermal or later HEAT/APFSDS inherited from T-55/T-62. Verify exact1951 profile/date.
Fixed existing nominal ammunition only after acceptance-date check. Preserve22round AZ/noERA/noATGM implementation; no later3BM42/3BM60 substitution.
Do not add AHEAD/proximity/programmable ammunition because other35mm models exist; exact1A1/1A2 fit remains pending.
Baselinewire-guidedTOW only after a carrier/ammo-matched profile; no TOW2/tandem/topattack/thermal upgrade by room year alone.

spaceR_ACM.scope: All currently radar-equipped aircraft, and additional radar-equipped profiles once implemented. No radar is invented on radarless airframes.
spaceR_ACM.classification: User-requested game assistance, not a historical avionics feature claim.
constraints: Use actual profile sensor range/visibility/terrain/clutter restrictions.
Do not add pulse-Doppler/look-down, HMD cueing, continuous-wave illumination or active missile integration.
No carrier compatibility is inferred from ACM.
Space+R remains the chord; do not replace it or disable it on early radar profiles.

sensorAndAssistancePolicy.otherAssistance: Current early-jet English/Russian voice warnings are documented game assistance. Keep assistance separate from factual hardware claims.
sightRules: A fixed/gyro sight is not automatically a real CCIP/CCRP or radar solution.
Bomb impact ring requires airborne state, a usable selected/carried bomb and an approved fire-control profile; no ring on ground or without bombs.
Correctly projected collimated reticle geometry can be shared across aircraft, but displayed symbology/computation must use each approved equipment profile.
PavePenny is a laser spot tracker, not a designator; Klen-PS is distinct from a modern TV/IR targeting pod.
